title: CPU Transcode Readiness
problem: Probe-derived transcode planning still treats CPU HLS fallback as always available even when FFmpeg lacks required software encoders.

evidence.summary: Opened the CPU transcode readiness lane and accepted ADR 0047 for probe-derived software encoder readiness.
Mapped probe-derived CPU HLS readiness from required libx264 and aac software encoder stages.
Rejected explicit CPU planning and hardware fallback-to-CPU when the CPU software pipeline is unavailable, with typed Admin readiness reasons.
Updated server fake FFmpeg probes and focused gates for CPU readiness.

continue_policy.notes: The CPU readiness lane is complete. Split source decoder requirements, HLS muxer/protocol probing, and startup degradation into separate follow-ons.
